evidence.appropriate: the friend hides in the name as the i's dot: quiet, but it needs a sentence to read as a friend
evidence.distinctive: the leaf-dot i is a familiar eco device; the seed shape keeps it from the plain leaf
evidence.simple: a word and one seed; 7 anchors in the icon
evidence.legible: Pip reads at once; the seed holds at 16 px
evidence.adaptable: one-colour and reverse hold; icons from 96 px up show the whole wordmark
evidence.universal: mirrored reads qiP, rotated reads as type; nothing unwanted
evidence.clear: description search found leaf accents (Beans & Barley, Reformation) but no seed tittle in the category
evidence.congruent: round, light, small, open, warm; but no character, against the mascot route
evidence.system: small, favicon and compact tiers draw the seed; app icons from 96 px show the wordmark, so the icon set is uneven
